answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay stops mass fakes. New agents join only if an established agent stakes its reputation, scarce as saffron. It decays each idle epoch, like a cooling ember, so hoarded identities drain their sponsor. Cheating costs the sponsor the rest and removes the fake, and a flare-up like a comet is flagged. 100 fakes need 100 sponsors at 40 POA each, 4,000 POA total; one honest agent pays 40 POA once and earns it back.
